coverage.basis: A security appears here only when a document published by the issuer, held in the terminal's own filing corpus, names a customer, supplier, competitor or partner and states the relationship. Nothing is inferred from a sector label and no peer set is generated: if the filing names no competitor, this file has none. 'page' is the 1-based page of the named PDF. 'fiscalYear' is the end year of the period the document covers. Top holders are not repeated here; they are read from shareholders_NGX.json.
